chapters.title: 0% Accuracy, 100% Luck
chapters.goal: Survive the Isekai tutorial by exploiting a glitch in the 'Luck' stat that guarantees critical hits on missed attacks.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a confused casualty to a high-variance glass cannon with a target on his back.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in a mundane accident and wakes up in the System's arrival lounge.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist realizes his 'broken' build requires specific gear to be viable outside the tutorial zone.

chapters.title: The Math of Murder
chapters.goal: Acquire the 'Running Shoes of the Coward' to enable the 'Hit & Run' portion of the build.
chapters.stakes_shift: Transition from accidental survival to intentional exploitation of game mechanics.

bridge.from_prev: Exiting the tutorial with a mountain of 'Missed' critical damage data.
bridge.to_next: A local dungeon offers the perfect testing ground for high-speed kiting.

chapters.title: Aggro Management for Idiots
chapters.goal: Clear the Wildwood Dungeon solo by kiting the boss into its own traps using superior movement speed.
chapters.stakes_shift: Local fame grows, attracting the attention of both fans and jealous 'balanced' players.

bridge.from_prev: Equipped with speed-boosting gear and a snarky attitude.
bridge.to_next: The 'Balance Committee'—a guild of enforcers—decides his build is an illegal exploit.

chapters.title: A Critical Error
chapters.goal: Escape an ambush by the Balance Committee by leaning into the most absurd physics glitches possible.
chapters.stakes_shift: The protagonist goes from being a player to a fugitive within the System.

bridge.from_prev: Winning too much and drawing the wrong kind of administrative eyes.
bridge.to_next: Realizing he can't outrun a whole guild alone; he needs a meat shield.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon Brigade
chapters.goal: Recruit a disgraced former tank who has the only 'Unstoppable' skill capable of keeping up with the protagonist.
chapters.stakes_shift: Individual survival becomes a tactical partnership with shared risks.

bridge.from_prev: Hiding in the slums of a major trade hub while being hunted.
bridge.to_next: Taking the fight to the Balance Committee's main resource node.

chapters.title: Running the Numbers
chapters.goal: Infiltrate the Spire of Math to delete the protagonist's 'Exploit' flag before the System auto-bans him.
chapters.stakes_shift: The protagonist's existence in this world is at stake; it's 'fix the flag' or 'get deleted'.

bridge.from_prev: A high-speed chase across the plains leading to the Spire.
bridge.to_next: The System's logic is rewritten, but the consequences are unpredictable.

chapters.title: Looting the Scene
chapters.goal: Secure the legendary 'Dev-Tool' drop from the Spire's guardian and vanish into the frontier.
chapters.stakes_shift: The protagonist is no longer just a glitch; he is now a permanent, powerful anomaly in the world.

bridge.from_prev: The Spire collapses as the 'Exploit' flag is converted into a 'Unique Title'.
bridge.to_next: Heading toward the next zone where the rules are even easier to break.
